newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia, Taiwan in "open skies" pact -minister.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia, Taiwan in "open skies" pact -minister.

text.p: Malaysia and Taiwan have agreed in principle to liberalise air travel, Malaysia's national news agency Bernama reported on Friday.
It quoted Transport Minister Ling Liong Sik as saying that the "open skies" pact with Taiwan would increase passenger and cargo traffic between the two countries.
Ling said he had discussed the air pact with his Taiwanese counterpart during the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation Transportation Ministerial Meeting in Victoria, Canada, earlier this week.
Malaysia has no political ties with Taiwan but the two countries conduct trade and investment cooperation.
Ling said similar air pacts were being worked out with other countries. Kuala Lumpur and Washington signed one such agreement last week.
